items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: I went to Fouad's home many times for dinner and recording sessions... The Cullaz couple were quite wealthy... I had never eaten curried food before and after the first visit to the Cullaz's, I never refused an invitation from them.

ctx.x: It was there that I heard for the first time Billie Holiday's recording of 'Miss Brown To You' with Teddy Wilson at the box. Fouad also had a photo of Bunny Berigan whom I had heard but never seen. Bunny's recording of 'I Can't Get Started with you' was the greatest he ever did to my estimation. And it is the only record other than some of Louis's that I copied note for note and I still play it the way Bunny did at times just for my own pleasure.

I went to Fouad's home many times for dinner and recording sessions because he was from a rich family and could afford to buy the latest records as soon as they were issued. The Cullaz couple were quite wealthy I presumed because they had a very nice appartment in the

Saint-Cloud section of Paris were many wealthy families lived. Venette cooked Asiatic food with the right amount of curry that made the food almost melt in one's mouth. I had never eaten curried food before and after the first visit to the Cullaz's, I never refused an invitation from them.
